name: PD 167 was established by Ordinance No. 18053, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 23, 1983. Ordinance No. 18053 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18053 has been amended by Ordinance No. 22648, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 10, 1996, and Ordinance No. 25359, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 10, 2003. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18053; 22648; 25359; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 167 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text: ARTICLE 167. PD 167.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 167 was established by Ordinance No. 18053, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 23, 1983. Ordinance No. 18053 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18053 has been amended by Ordinance No. 22648, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 10, 1996, and Ordinance No. 25359, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 10, 2003. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18053; 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 167 is established on property generally located east of Greenville Avenue and west of the west line of Matilda Street, between Belmont Avenue and the alley between Prospect Avenue and Oram Street. The size of PD 167 is approximately 8.2 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18053; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.103.DEFINITIONS. Except as otherwise provided in this article, the definitions in Chapter 51 apply to this article. In this article, MASSAGE PARLOR means a facility operated for the primary business purpose of practicing the art of massage upon the human body with or without the use of mechanical, therapeutic, or bathing devices. This use does not include a facility operated under a physician’s direction or where registered physical therapists treat only patients recommended by a licensed physician. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.104.INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Creation Of Tracts
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.105.CREATION OF TRACTS. This PD is divided into two separate tracts, Tracts A and B, as shown on the map labelled Exhibit 167A. [Note: Ordinance No. 22648 created a Tract B-1. The map attached to that ordinance is labelled Exhibit 167B for reference.] (Ord. Nos. 18053; 22648; 25508)

sections.title: Applicability Of Other Codes And Ordinances
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.106.APPLICABILITY OF OTHER CODES AND ORDINANCES. Unless otherwise expressly provided herein, the provisions of the Dallas Development Code as they existed on the date of passage of Ordinance No. 18053 [November 23, 1983] shall apply to this PD as if it were zoned General Retail (GR). All other applicable codes and ordinances of the city shall apply to this PD as exist on the date of passage of Ordinance No. 18053 and as they may be amended in the future. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.107.USES.
(a)Permitted uses in general. Except for uses that are expressly prohibited or limited in this article, all uses permitted in a General Retail (GR) District are permitted in this PD.
(b)Prohibited uses in Tract A. The following uses are prohibited in Tract A:
(1)Bar, lounge, or tavern.
(2)Hotel and motel.
(3)Inside commercial amusement, except where incidental to a main use that is permitted in Tract A.
(4)Private club.
(5)Service station.
(6)Automobile or motorcycle display, sales, and service.
(7)Auto parts sales.
(8)Auto glass, muffler, or seat cover shop.
(9)Auto repair garage.
(10)Car wash.
(11)Pawn shop.
(12)Massage parlor.
(c)Restaurants in Tract A. Although alcoholic beverages may be served, and music, entertainment, and facilities for dancing may be provided in restaurants in Tract A, the primary function of these establishments must be the sale and service of food.
(d)Prohibited uses in Tract B. The following uses are prohibited in Tract B:
(1)Service station.
(2)Automobile or motorcycle display, sales, and service.
(3)Auto parts sales.
(4)Auto glass, muffler, or seat cover shop.
(5)Auto repair garage.
(6)Car wash.
(7)Pawn shop.
(8)Massage parlor.
(e)Abandoned right-of-way. Any right-of-way along Belmont Avenue and Richmond Avenue that is abandoned by the city must be used only for off-street parking, walkways, or driveways.
(f)Permitted uses in Tract B-1. The following uses are permitted in Tract B-1:
(1)Single-family.
(2)Private street or alley.
(3)Local utilities.
(4)Accessory community center (private) (permitted only as an accessory uses). (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Noise Regulations
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.108.NOISE REGULATIONS. A person shall not conduct a use in this PD that creates a noise level exceeding the maximum permissible levels for office and commercial districts under Section 51-6.102(c). (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.109.MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage for buildings and structures in this PD is 60 percent, except that maximum lot coverage in Tract B-1 is 80 percent. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Setback And Height Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.110.SETBACK AND HEIGHT REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Minimum front yard setback for a building or structure along Richmond Avenue or Prospect Avenue is 10 feet. If a building or structure along Richmond Avenue or Prospect Avenue is erected or altered to exceed 36 feet in height, an additional setback of 15 feet must be provided for the portion of the building or structure that exceeds 36 feet in height.
(b)Minimum front yard setback for a building or structure along Matilda Street is 10 feet. If a building or structure along Matilda Street is erected or altered to exceed 24 feet in height, an additional setback of 15 feet must be provided for the portion of building or structure that exceeds 24 feet in height. If a building or structure along Matilda Street is erected or altered to exceed 36 feet in height, an additional setback must be provided that is equal to twice the height of the portion of the building that exceeds 36 feet in height.
(c)If a setback is measured from a right-of-way line along Belmont Avenue or Richmond Avenue and all or a portion of the right-of-way is later abandoned by the city, the setback must continue to be measured from the original right-of-way line as it existed on November 23, 1983.
(d)Maximum permitted height for a building or structure in Tract A is 60 feet. Maximum permitted height for a building or structure in Tract B is 80 feet.
(e)Tract B-1 must comply with the setback and height requirements of the TH-3 Townhouse District of Chapter 51, except that:
(1)Minimum setback from Prospect Street for a building or structure in Tract B-1 is 10 feet.
(2)Minimum setback from the existing alley for a building or structure in Tract B-1 is three feet.
(3)A minimum of 15 feet between each group of eight attached single-family structures in Tract B-1 must be provided by the plat.
(4)Maximum permitted height for a building or structure in Tract B-1 is 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area Ratio
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.111.MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA RATIO. No maximum floor area ratio requirement for this PD. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Access Restrictions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.112.ACCESS RESTRICTIONS.
(a)No main entrances to nonresidential buildings may face onto Matilda Street.
(b)No new curb cuts are permitted along Matilda Street. Existing curb cuts must be used to provide access to existing uses only.
(c)The following access restrictions apply only to Tract B-1:
(1)Ingress and egress for Tract B-1 may be controlled by access gates as shown on the development plan for Tract B-1 (Exhibit 167C).
(2)An access easement may be used to provide access to Lots 5 and 6 in Tract B-1 as shown on the development plan for Tract B-1.
(3)An access easement may be used to provide access to Lots 10, 11, and 12 in Tract B-1 as shown on the development plan for Tract B-1.
(4)A private street, court, or plaza with a minimum right-of-way width of 30 feet must be constructed in Tract B-1 in the location shown on the development plan for Tract B-1. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.113.OFF-STREET PARKING REGULATIONS.
(a)Multiple-family uses in this PD must provide at least one space for each 600 square feet of dwelling unit floor area, but no more than two spaces for each dwelling unit are required.
(b)Retail uses in this PD which are required by the Dallas Development Code to provide a minimum of one space for each 200 square feet of floor area may provide a minimum of one space for each 250 square feet of floor area.
(c)Single-family uses in Tract B-1 must provide at least two spaces for each dwelling unit. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.114.SIGNS.
(a)Attached signs in Tract A may have an effective area of 50 square feet per occupant.
(b)No attached signs in Tract A may face onto Matilda Street, except street address signs and other signs required by law.
(c)No detached signs in Tract A may be placed within 25 feet of the right-of-way line along Matilda Street.
(d)Except as otherwise expressly provided above, all signs in Tract A must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code.
(e)The provisions of Section 51-7.404(a)(5) governing attached signs above the first 24 feet of building height apply to this PD as though it were zoned an O-2 Office-2 District.
(f)All signs in Tract B must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code.
(g)All signs in Tract B-1 must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping And Screening Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.115.LANDSCAPING AND SCREENING REQUIREMENTS.
(a)A person shall not remove or destroy a tree of over 10-inch caliper existing in a healthy, growing condition in a parkway or front yard along Belmont Avenue or Matilda Avenue unless he immediately replaces it with a tree of at least three and one-half-inch caliper on the same blockface.
(b)Walls, driveways, and off-street parking (required or excess) are not permitted in the first three feet of the required front yard along Matilda Street. This area must be planted with natural turf, ground cover, or other plant materials.
(c)All parking areas in Tract A which are visible from Belmont Avenue or Matilda Street, except those areas which are only visible by sight lines which cross existing alleys, must be screened by a solid masonry (not concrete block) wall, solid evergreen perennial plantings, planted earthen berm, or any combination of these. The screening must be at least three and one-half feet in height.
(d)All rear and service sides of buildings and garbage storage areas in Tract A which are visible from Belmont Avenue or Matilda Street, except those sides and areas which are only visible by sight lines which cross existing alleys, must be screened by a solid masonry (not concrete block) wall that is at least six feet in height.
(e)Landscaping in Tract B-1 must comply with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Boards Of Adjustment
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.116.BOARDS OF ADJUSTMENT. The board of adjustment and sign control board of adjustment have the same powers and duties with respect to properties and signs in this PD as they have with respect to properties and signs in a GR General Retail District, with the following exception: In addition to the powers and duties of the sign control board of adjustment enumerated in Section 51-7.703(d), the sign control board of adjustment may, in specific cases and subject to appropriate conditions, permit a variance for any sign in Tract A of this PD of up to 25 percent of the setback, effective area, and height requirements contained in this article or in Article VII, after proper notice and hearing in accordance with the standards and requirements contained in that section and article. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Certain Pd Regulations Not Applicable
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.117.CERTAIN PD REGULATIONS NOT APPLICABLE.
(a)Compliance with the provisions of Subsections (b) through (h) of Section 51-4.702, relating to site plan procedures, site analyses, conceptual plans, development plans, is not required for any person who seeks an approval, permit, or certificate from the city in connection with the development or occupancy of property in this PD, except as provided in Subsection (b).
(b)Development and use of Tract B-1 must comply with the development plan for Tract B-1. In the case of a conflict between the provisions of this section and the development plan for Tract B-1, the provisions of this section control. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.118.FENCING.
(a)Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy within Tract B-1, a minimum eight- foot-high fence must be constructed along Prospect Street as shown on the development plan for Tract B- 1.
(b)An eight-foot-high solid temporary fence may be constructed along the north, east, and west property lines of Tract B-1 during periods of construction. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association In Tract B-1
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.119.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION IN TRACT B-1. Prior to final plat approval, the owners of the Property must execute an instrument creating a homeowners’ association for the maintenance of common areas, screening walls, landscape areas (including perimeter landscaping areas), private streets, courts or plazas, and for other functions. This instrument must be approved as to form by the city attorney, approved by the city plan commission and filed in the Dallas County Deed Records. (Ord. No. 22648; 25359; 25508)

sections.title: Additional Conditions For Tract B-1
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-167.120.ADDITIONAL CONDITIONS FOR TRACT B-1.
(a)Tract B-1 must be maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.
(b)Development and use of Tract B-1 must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25359; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.121.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.122.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 22648; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-167.123.ZONING MAP. PD 167 is located on Zoning Map No. I-8. (Ord. Nos. 18053; 25508)
